searchText: https://security.ethereum.org/wishlist <- for the wishlist tools here, does anyone have suggestions on what clients / particular codebases would be good places to start testing out these tools if i built them? I would like to try them on codebases that could use more rigorous testing As we improve Besu performance of some core EVM components (which tend to have less comprehensive reference tests than newer EIPs), it's been useful to have differential fuzzing to regression test against other clients. Not sure if that's an additional item on the wishlist. excerpts.author: siladu
excerpts.content:
As we improve Besu performance of some core EVM components (which tend to have less comprehensive reference tests than newer EIPs), it's been useful to have differential fuzzing to regression test against other clients. 
Not sure if that's an additional item on the wishlist. I guess Differential LLMing could help us here as well, to tease out client-specifics optimisations (or lack of)
